enchantments.tooltip: Psychic Ward: This items wards you against mind-altering effects and spells, such as Charm and Domination.
Good Luck +5: This item gives a +5 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Reflex Save +13: This item gives a +13 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Quality Alluring Skills Bonus: +5 Quality bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
